messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick Q for anyone who travels a lot: if you opt into per diem for a 2-day domestic trip, can you still submit itemized receipts for the second day if you went over the per diem?
Priya (Eng): I ran into this last week. I thought per diem means you pick it and that's it 5
Diego (Travel Admin): Correct: choose per diem OR itemized for each travel day. You can't mix for the same day.
Priya (Eng): Got it. But what if day 2 is itemized and totals less than per diem, do I get the per diem difference?
Noah (Finance): You only get whichever method you submitted. If you submit itemized and it's less than the per diem, we reimburse the itemized amount, not the per diem.
Maya (People Ops): Policy note: partial travel days have reduced per diem (see intranet). If you want the higher of the two, submit per diem for that day and don't submit receipts for it.
Priya (Eng): Is there a floor for items that don't need receipts? I had a $22 breakfast with no receipt.
Diego (Travel Admin): Small incidentals under $25 can be summarized on a single expense with card statement, but meals included in per diem should not be double-submitted.
Noah (Finance): Also note: if you use company card for meals while on per diem, we still require the charge to be coded and noted as "Company Card on Per Diem Day". We will offset the per diem by that amount if it exceeds policy.
Maya (People Ops): International tip: some countries require itemized VAT invoices for VAT reclaim. If you're trying to recover VAT, use itemized receipts, not per diem.
Priya (Eng): What about partial team dinners where some people are on per diem and others on itemized?
Diego (Travel Admin): Split the dinner into separate expense lines: per-diem employees should not attach receipts for that night. For itemized employees, attach their receipt and mark attendees.
Maya (People Ops): If in doubt, flag your manager for pre-approval. For any day where total person spend >$150 we need manager justification.
expense-bot: Expense policy reminder: per diem election must be made at time of report creation. See https://intranet.redwood/policies/travel#per-diem for rates and examples.
